fProcesses.name: f
fProcesses.description: Select the output format of the response. If no value is provided, the standard HTTP rules apply, i.e., the accept header will be used to determine the format.

limitProcesses.name: limit
limitProcesses.description: The optional limit parameter limits the number of process summaries that are presented in the response document.

offsetProcesses.name: offset
offsetProcesses.description: The optional offset parameter identifies the index of the first process summary in the response in the overall result set.
